description: Add debts — **several in one call**. A debt is the original principal plus a stream of payments; **the balance is derived, never stored**, so there is nothing here that sets one. Optionally set how payments are discovered: a merchant pattern for a standing order, or a category. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Editing, closing and deleting a debt are app-only, as is promoting a card installment group.

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

debts.description: One entry per debt. Up to 60 in a call.

expected_end_date.description: When it is due to be paid off, as YYYY-MM-DD.

kind.description: One of MORTGAGE, BANK_LOAN, CARD_INSTALLMENTS, PAYROLL_LOAN, PERSONAL, OTHER.

monthly_payment.description: The expected payment, used to project a payoff date before there is any history.

note.description: Anything worth keeping — the lender, the rate, the agreement.

opened_date.description: When it was taken on, as YYYY-MM-DD.

principal_amount.description: The original amount borrowed, in major units — not what is left. Outstanding is this minus the principal of every payment.

tracking_kind.description: How payments are found: NONE (entered by hand — money owed to a friend), MERCHANT_PATTERN (a standing order, matched against the normalized merchant), or CATEGORY. A payroll-deducted loan is not set here — that link is the deduction type’s "Pays into", set with `set_deduction_types`.

tracking_ref.description: The merchant pattern, or a category id from `category_tree`. Required unless tracking_kind is NONE.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: create_debts
title: Create debts
